commentary.text: 90+7' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+5' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Dani Parejo (Villarreal) was quite harsh and Victor Garcia didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
90+2' That will be all from Alex Baena who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Alfonso Pedraza (Villarreal).

90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
89' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Rayo Vallecano comes to nothing.
89' Andrei Ratiu (Rayo Vallecano) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
87' Here is a change. Pedro Diaz is going off and Inigo Perez gives the last tactical orders to Oscar Trejo (Rayo Vallecano).
87' Alvaro Garcia comes off the pitch to be replaced by Etienne Eto'o (Rayo Vallecano).

85' The corner is swung in but Villarreal can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
83' Great teamplay by Villarreal as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
80' Marcelino has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Tajon Buchanan (Villarreal) replacing Thierno Barry.

80' Ayoze Perez (Villarreal) clutches his head in despair after blowing a huge opportunity! He receives the ball after the free kick and takes good first touch to unleash a low shot from close range, but Augusto Batalla makes a nice save.
78' Andrei Ratiu (Rayo Vallecano) has tested the patience of referee Victor Garcia and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.

73' Inigo Perez has decided to make a change. Sergio Guardiola (Rayo Vallecano) replaces Randy Nteka.
71' What an amazing save by Diego Conde! Randy Nteka (Rayo Vallecano) swirls around the defenders and attempts to beat the keeper with a close-range shot towards the bottom left corner, but fails.
70' Rayo Vallecano have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
